name: low_output
detection: own attempts per minute, per round
coaching_line: Volume. You are not throwing enough to win rounds.

name: output_fade
detection: own landed in round N vs round N-1
coaching_line: Your output fell off a cliff from last round. Get it back.

name: round3_collapse
detection: round 3 attempts vs round 1 attempts
coaching_line: Third round was half the first. Pace yourself or fix your gas tank.

name: slow_start
detection: attempts in first 60 s of round / attempts in round
coaching_line: Start faster. You spent the first minute watching.

name: late_flurry_only
coach_sees: Only works in the last minute
detection: attempts in last 60 s / attempts in round
coaching_line: Stealing the last minute does not win the round. Spread it out.

name: outworked
detection: own attempts / opponent attempts, per round
coaching_line: You are getting outworked. Match his volume at minimum.

name: dead_stretch
detection: longest window with zero own attempts
coaching_line: Thirty seconds without a strike. Stay busy.

name: metronome_rhythm
detection: coefficient of variation of gaps between own attempts
coaching_line: Same rhythm every time. Break it up so he cannot time you.

name: single_shots
coach_sees: Throws one strike at a time
detection: share of attempts with no own follow-up within 1.5 s
coaching_line: Singles. Put strikes together.

name: no_three_strike_combos
detection: count of 3+ own strikes within 2.5 s
coaching_line: No combinations. Two is not a combination.

name: low_accuracy
detection: landed / attempts
coaching_line: Accuracy is down. Set them up instead of throwing to throw.

name: high_miss_rate
detection: missed / attempts
coaching_line: You are punching air. Close the distance first.

name: high_blocked_rate
detection: blocked / attempts
coaching_line: He sees everything coming. Hide it behind the jab.

name: combo_repeat
detection: most common 3-strike own sequence, count per round
coaching_line: Same combo three times. He is waiting on it now.

name: predictable_opener
coach_sees: Always starts with the same strike
detection: share of own combos starting with the same strike
coaching_line: You open every combo the same way. Change the first strike.

name: predictable_finisher
coach_sees: Always ends with the same strike
detection: share of own combos ending with the same strike
coaching_line: He knows what the last shot is. Finish somewhere else.

name: level_never_changes
detection: share of own 2+ strike combos with all strikes to the same target
coaching_line: Change levels inside the combo. Head, body, head.

name: no_jab_setup_for_power
detection: cross/hook/overhand not preceded by own jab within 1 s
coaching_line: Jab first. Your power shots have no setup.

name: naked_kicks
detection: kicks not preceded by own punch within 1.2 s
coaching_line: Kick behind punches. Naked kicks get caught.

name: no_follow_after_landing
detection: own landed strike with no own follow-up within 1.5 s
coaching_line: When it lands, stay on him. You keep stopping after the first one.

name: head_hunting
detection: head share of own attempts
coaching_line: All head. Go to the body and the guard will open.

name: no_body_work
detection: body share of own attempts
coaching_line: Zero body work. Start investing there in round one.

name: no_leg_kicks
detection: leg-target kicks share of own attempts
coaching_line: No leg kicks. Take his base.

name: one_weapon
coach_sees: One strike does all the work
detection: largest single strike type share of own landed
coaching_line: One weapon is carrying you. He will take it away.

name: jab_absent
detection: jab share of own punches
coaching_line: Where is the jab? Everything comes off it.

name: never_doubles_jab
detection: count of own jab-jab within 1 s
coaching_line: Double the jab. One jab is a range finder, two is an attack.

name: jab_cross_only
detection: jab + cross share of own punches
coaching_line: Straight punches only. Add hooks and uppercuts.

name: no_inside_weapons
detection: elbow + knee + uppercut count
coaching_line: No inside game. When it gets close you have nothing.

name: rear_hand_dependency
detection: cross + overhand share of own landed punches
coaching_line: Lead hand is dead. All your damage is the rear hand and he knows it.

name: no_hooks
detection: hook count
coaching_line: No hooks. You cannot go around a high guard.

name: no_teep
detection: teep count
coaching_line: No teep. You have no way to keep him off you.

name: same_strike_stretch
coach_sees: Repeats the same strike in a row
detection: longest run of consecutive own attempts of the same type
coaching_line: Five of the same strike in a row. Mix it.

name: high_absorption
detection: opponent landed per minute
coaching_line: You are eating too much. Tighten up.

name: head_absorption
coach_sees: Takes it all on the head
detection: head share of opponent landed
coaching_line: Everything he lands is on your head. Hands up, chin down.

name: body_worn_down
detection: opponent body strikes landed per round
coaching_line: He is investing in your body. Elbows in.

name: eats_leg_kicks
detection: opponent leg kick landed rate (min 4 thrown)
coaching_line: Check the leg kicks. He is landing every one.

name: eats_body_kicks
detection: opponent body kick landed rate (min 3 thrown)
coaching_line: Body kicks are getting through. Catch or block.

name: head_kick_landed
detection: opponent head kicks landed
coaching_line: He landed a head kick. Your rear hand was not there.

name: same_strike_repeated
detection: most landed opponent strike type, count per round
coaching_line: Same shot four times. Find it and shut it down.

name: opponent_accuracy_high
detection: opponent landed / opponent attempts
coaching_line: He is landing half of what he throws. Make him miss.

name: absorption_rises
detection: opponent landed per round, increasing every round
coaching_line: You get easier to hit as the fight goes on.

name: late_round_absorption
detection: share of opponent landed in last 60 s
coaching_line: You are eating shots in the last minute. That is where rounds are scored.

name: hit_after_throwing
detection: opponent landed within 1.5 s after own attempt / own attempts
coaching_line: You are getting hit after you throw. Get out after the combo.

name: trades_when_landing
detection: own landed followed by opponent landed within 1.5 s
coaching_line: Every time you land you take one back. Land and leave.

name: no_response_after_hit
detection: share of opponent landed with no own attempt within 2 s
coaching_line: When he hits you, hit back. You freeze.

name: no_counter_rate
detection: own attempts within 1 s after opponent attempt / opponent attempts
coaching_line: No counters. He throws for free.

name: no_counter_to_misses
detection: opponent misses with no own attempt within 1 s
coaching_line: He is missing and you are not making him pay.

name: lets_kicker_reset
detection: opponent kicks with no own attempt within 1.2 s
coaching_line: He kicks and resets for free. Counter the kick.

name: hands_low_at_rest
detection: frames with both wrists below chin, non-striking frames only
coaching_line: Hands are low the whole fight. Up.

name: rear_hand_drops_on_jab
coach_sees: Drops the rear hand when jabbing
detection: rear wrist below cheek during own jab frames
coaching_line: Rear hand drops on the jab. That is where the counter comes.

name: lead_hand_drops_on_cross
coach_sees: Drops the lead hand when throwing the cross
detection: lead wrist below cheek during own cross frames
coaching_line: Lead hand falls when you throw the right. Keep it home.

name: slow_hand_return
detection: time for striking wrist to return to guard height after own strike
coaching_line: Bring it back faster. The hand is out there too long.

name: guard_drops_after_combo
detection: guard height 1 s after combo vs 1 s before
coaching_line: Hands fall after you combo. Finish the combo with the guard up.

name: guard_decays_in_round
coach_sees: Hands drift down as the round goes
detection: linear trend of guard height across the round
coaching_line: Hands get lower every minute. Fatigue or habit, fix it.

name: guard_drops_when_retreating
detection: guard height while moving away from opponent vs stationary
coaching_line: You drop your hands when you back up. That is when he follows.

name: wide_guard
coach_sees: Guard is open in the middle
detection: horizontal wrist-to-nose distance at rest
coaching_line: Guard is wide. Straight punches go right down the middle.

name: elbows_flared
detection: elbow horizontal offset from torso line at rest
coaching_line: Elbows in. Your body is wide open.

name: chin_up
detection: nose height relative to shoulder line, at rest
coaching_line: Chin down. Tuck it behind the shoulder.

name: arm_hangs_extended
detection: elbow angle > 150 deg held after own punch
coaching_line: Arm stays out after you punch. Snap it back.

name: hand_drops_on_kick
detection: same-side wrist below shoulder during own round kick
coaching_line: Hand drops every time you kick. That is the counter right hand.

name: hands_at_waist_in_range
coach_sees: Hands at the hips inside range
detection: frames with wrists below hips while inside punching range
coaching_line: Hands at your waist in punching range. Unacceptable.

name: static_head
detection: lateral head position std dev over 10 s windows
coaching_line: Head is on a stick. Move it.

name: no_head_movement_after_punch
detection: lateral head displacement in 0.7 s after own punch
coaching_line: Punch and move your head. Right now you punch and wait.

name: no_slip_on_incoming
detection: head off-centerline displacement while opponent punches
coaching_line: You block everything with your face. Slip.

name: leans_back_to_avoid
detection: torso tilts back > 20 deg with no foot movement on opponent punches
coaching_line: Leaning back. You get away from the first one and eat the second.

name: ducks_straight_down
detection: head drops > 0.5 head heights with lateral < 0.2 on opponent punches
coaching_line: Ducking straight down into the uppercut. Slip to the side.

name: head_over_lead_knee
detection: nose x beyond lead knee x
coaching_line: Head is out over your front foot. You are off balance and open.

name: enters_with_still_head
coach_sees: Comes in on a straight line with a still head
detection: lateral head movement while closing distance
coaching_line: When you come in, move your head. You walk into the jab.

name: head_pulls_straight_back
coach_sees: Pulls the head straight back after combos
detection: head displacement direction after own combo, lateral component
coaching_line: Straight back after the combo. Angle off instead.

name: stance_narrow
detection: ankle distance in shoulder widths
coaching_line: Stance is narrow. One shove and you are down.

name: stance_wide
detection: ankle distance in shoulder widths
coaching_line: Stance is too wide. You cannot move from there.

name: feet_crossed
detection: lead/rear ankle order flips during lateral movement, count per round
coaching_line: You crossed your feet. Step, do not cross.

name: square_to_opponent
detection: shoulder line angle relative to line to opponent
coaching_line: You are square. Turn your shoulder and give him less to hit.

name: no_bounce
detection: ankle vertical variance over 5 s windows
coaching_line: Flat feet. Get on your toes.

name: weight_forward
detection: hip midpoint position between ankles
coaching_line: Weight is on your front foot. That is why the leg kick hurts.

name: overextends_cross
detection: hip midpoint passes lead ankle during own cross
coaching_line: You fall into your right hand. Sit down on it instead.

name: rear_foot_lifts_on_punch
detection: rear ankle rises during own punch
coaching_line: Back foot comes off the floor when you punch. No power without it.

name: off_balance_after_kick
detection: support ankle moves > 0.3 shin lengths or torso > 30 deg in 0.5 s after own kick
coaching_line: You are off balance after every kick. Bring it back to stance.

name: stance_collapses_retreating
detection: ankle distance while retreating vs stationary
coaching_line: Your feet come together when you back up. Step back, do not shuffle.

name: backs_straight_up
detection: retreat direction within 15 deg of line to opponent
coaching_line: Straight back. Straight back is where the fence is.

name: net_retreat
detection: net displacement away from opponent over the round
coaching_line: You gave ground the whole round. Judges see that.

name: circles_into_power
detection: lateral movement toward opponent's rear-hand side
coaching_line: You keep circling into his right. Go the other way.

name: no_lateral_movement
detection: lateral share of total displacement
coaching_line: No side to side. You are a train on a track.

name: fence_time
detection: frames within 1 body width of cage
coaching_line: You spent a third of the round on the fence. Get off it.

name: gives_up_center
detection: opponent closer to cage center than you
coaching_line: He owns the center. Take it back.

name: no_angle_after_combo
detection: lateral displacement in 1 s after own combo
coaching_line: Combo and step off. You combo and stand there.

name: exits_straight_back
detection: post-combo retreat within 15 deg of line to opponent
coaching_line: You leave the same way you came in. Angle out.

name: enters_straight
coach_sees: Comes in on a straight line
detection: approach vector within 10 deg of line to opponent
coaching_line: Every entry is straight down the pipe. Come in at an angle.

name: steps_in_without_strike
detection: distance closed > 0.5 body widths with no own attempt within 1 s, count
coaching_line: You step in and do nothing. Step in with something.

name: stationary
detection: total path length per round in body widths
coaching_line: You barely moved. A moving target is harder to hit.

name: lead_foot_inside
coach_sees: Loses the lead-foot battle in open stance
detection: own lead ankle inside opponent's lead ankle, open-stance matchups only
coaching_line: Get your lead foot outside his. You are losing the foot battle.

name: no_pivot_on_kick
coach_sees: No hip turn on round kicks
detection: hip line rotation during own round kick
coaching_line: No hips in the kick. Pivot the support foot.

name: slow_kick_retraction
detection: time for kicking ankle to return to floor
coaching_line: Get the leg back. He catches it, you are on your back.

name: leans_back_on_kick
detection: torso angle backward during own round kick
coaching_line: You lean away from your own kick. No power, no balance.

name: doesnt_check_kicks
detection: lead knee rise within 0.3 s of opponent leg kick
coaching_line: You never check. Lift the knee.

name: checks_late
detection: knee rise begins after opponent kick contact frame
coaching_line: Your check is late. React to the hip, not the leg.

name: punches_out_of_range
detection: own punch attempts with inter-fighter distance > reach + 0.3 body widths
coaching_line: You are punching from a step too far. Close first.

name: idle_in_range
detection: time inside punching range with no attempt by either fighter, episodes > 2 s
coaching_line: You are standing in his range. Throw or leave.

name: clinch_time_high
coach_sees: Spends too long in the clinch
detection: frames with torso distance < 0.6 body widths
coaching_line: A third of the round in the clinch. Break and strike.

name: passive_in_clinch
detection: clinch episodes with zero own strikes lasting > 5 s, count
coaching_line: You are holding in the clinch. Knees, elbows, or get out.
